body.body: ### SUMMARY `superset/models/helpers.py` imported `pytz` solely for one UTC conversion in `changed_on_utc`. Replaced with stdlib `datetime.timezone.utc` and dropped the `pytz` import from the module. Semantics note: `changed_on` is stored as a *naive* datetime already in UTC. The old code called `astimezone(pytz.utc)`, which makes Python interpret the naive value in the process's **local** timezone before converting — correct only when the server runs in UTC, wrong otherwise. The replacement attaches UTC explicitly rather than reinterpreting: ```python changed_on = self.changed_on if changed_on.tzinfo is None: changed_on = changed_on.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) return changed_on.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z") ``` Already-aware values keep the previous `astimezone` behaviour. Output is byte-identical for naive UTC input (verified: `2024-01-02T03:04:05.123456+0000` from both old and new paths). Closes #4 ### TESTING INSTRUCTIONS ``` python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/models/helpers_test.py -q # 147 passed ruff check superset/models/helpers.py # All checks passed! ``` ### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION - [x] Has associated issue: #4 - [ ] Required feature flags: - [ ] Changes UI - [ ] Includes DB Migration (follow approval process in [SIP-59](https://github.com/apache/superset/issues/13351)) - [ ] Migration is atomic, supports rollback & is backwards-compatible - [ ] Confirm DB migration upgrade and downgrade tested - [ ] Runtime estimates and downtime expectations provided - [ ] Introduces new feature or API - [ ] Removes existing feature or API Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/0c13b096a4bf4075ab3f52d1a0b18f40 ---

body.body: ### SUMMARY `superset/utils/dates.py` was the only thing keeping `pytz` in this module. The two call sites need different replacements: - `dttm.astimezone(pytz.utc)` converts an already-aware datetime, so it maps directly to `datetime.timezone.utc` (no `zoneinfo` lookup needed — UTC is a stdlib constant, and `ZoneInfo("UTC")` would only add a tzdata dependency for the same offset). - `pytz.utc.localize(EPOCH)` *attaches* UTC to the naive `EPOCH` constant. The stdlib equivalent for attaching (not converting) is `EPOCH.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`. Using `EPOCH.astimezone(timezone.utc)` instead would interpret `EPOCH` in the machine's local timezone and shift every aware-input epoch conversion by the local UTC offset — that's the failure mode of a blind find-and-replace here. `EPOCH` stays naive so the `dttm - EPOCH` branch for naive inputs is untouched. No other module changed. ### TESTING INSTRUCTIONS ``` python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/models/helpers_test.py tests/unit_tests/utils/test_date_parsing.py -q # 168 passed, 1 warning in 4.63s python -c "from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta; from superset.utils.dates import datetime_to_epoch; assert datetime_to_epoch(datetime(2020,1,1)) == 1577836800000.0; assert datetime_to_epoch(datetime(2020,1,1,tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=5)))) == 1577818800000.0; print('ok')" # ok ruff check superset/utils/dates.py # All checks passed! ``` Closes #1 ### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION - [x] Has associated issue: #1 - [ ] Required feature flags: - [ ] Changes UI - [ ] Includes DB Migration (follow approval process in [SIP-59](https://github.com/apache/superset/issues/13351)) - [ ] Migration is atomic, supports rollback & is backwards-compatible - [ ] Confirm DB migration upgrade and downgrade tested - [ ] Runtime estimates and downtime expectations provided - [ ] Introduces new feature or API - [ ] Removes existing feature or API Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/b9384faa460e4d96a7ea7e6a5d6db896 ---

body.body:
`superset/reports/schemas.py` validates the report timezone against
`pytz.all_timezones` and `superset/reports/notifications/email.py` uses
`pytz.timezone`. The stdlib equivalent, `zoneinfo.available_timezones()`,
returns an unordered `set`, so a naive substitution makes the API's
validation error message — which lists the accepted values, and which an
integration test asserts on — non-deterministic between processes.

Migrate both modules to `zoneinfo`, keeping the choices deterministic and
the accepted timezone set at least as permissive as today's.

<details><summary>Environment</summary>

The repository's Python environment is pre-built in the session snapshot. If
it is missing, recreate it once, from the repo root:

    sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y default-libmysqlclient-dev \
      pkg-config build-essential libsasl2-dev libldap2-dev
    curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
    uv venv --python 3.11 .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
    uv pip install -r requirements/development.txt && uv pip install -e .

Targeted unit tests then run in seconds. Do not run the full test suite, do
not build the frontend, and do not start Superset.

</details>

## Affected paths

- `superset/reports/schemas.py`
- `superset/reports/notifications/email.py`

## Acceptance criteria

- Neither module imports `pytz`
- The `OneOf` choices are deterministically ordered (sorted), not set-ordered
- Every timezone previously accepted is still accepted
- tests/unit_tests/reports/schemas_test.py passes

## Verification commands

```bash
python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/reports/schemas_test.py -q
python -c "import superset.reports.schemas as s; assert 'pytz' not in open(s.__file__).read(); print('ok')"
```

body.body: ### SUMMARY `superset/security/session_invalidation.py` compares a timezone-aware "now" (the session's `_login_at`) against `sessions_invalidated_at`, a **naive** UTC `DateTime` column. `_as_utc_timestamp` treats a naive value as UTC precisely because `datetime.timestamp()` on a naive datetime interprets it in the process local zone — if the helper didn't force UTC, the epoch would skew by the local UTC offset under a non-UTC `TZ` and sessions would be invalidated early or never. That invariant previously rested only on a docstring. This adds unit tests that pin it. No production module is modified. New test `test_naive_utc_matches_aware_utc_under_non_utc_tz` (parametrized over `America/Los_Angeles`, `Asia/Kolkata`, `Europe/Berlin`, `Pacific/Chatham` — east/west of UTC plus a fractional-hour zone) sets the process `TZ` via a `process_tz` fixture (`os.environ["TZ"]` + `time.tzset()`, restored on teardown so the zone doesn't leak into later tests) and asserts: - `_as_utc_timestamp(naive) == aware.timestamp()` - `_as_utc_timestamp(naive) == _as_utc_timestamp(aware)` - the `is_session_invalidated` boundary (just-before invalidated, just-after valid) holds, and the naive column and its aware equivalent invalidate identically. A sanity assertion (`time.timezone != 0 or time.altzone != 0`) confirms the chosen zone really is offset from UTC in-process, so the skew guard is actually exercised. The production behaviour is correct as documented; no change to it was needed. ### BEFORE/AFTER SCREENSHOTS OR ANIMATED GIF N/A ### TESTING INSTRUCTIONS ```bash python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/security -q ``` Result: `244 passed` (was 240; +4 new parametrized cases). `ruff check` on the changed file passes. ### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Closes #9 - [x] Has associated issue: #9 - [ ] Required feature flags: - [ ] Changes UI - [ ] Includes DB Migration (follow approval process in [SIP-59](https://github.com/apache/superset/issues/13351)) - [ ] Migration is atomic, supports rollback & is backwards-compatible - [ ] Confirm DB migration upgrade and downgrade tested - [ ] Runtime estimates and downtime expectations provided - [ ] Introduces new feature or API - [ ] Removes existing feature or API Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/29ab115a7eb04aed848fc159d86683f2 ---

body.body:
### SUMMARY

Drops `pytz` from the two report modules in favor of the stdlib `zoneinfo`.

Closes #3

Each call site needed a different replacement:

- `superset/reports/schemas.py`: `pytz.all_timezones` (a sorted `list`) → `zoneinfo.available_timezones()` (an unordered `set`). A direct substitution would make the `OneOf` choices — and therefore the API validation error message that enumerates the accepted values — non-deterministic across processes, since set iteration order depends on the hash seed. The set is materialized once at import into a module-level `TIMEZONES = tuple(sorted(available_timezones()))` and used by both `timezone` fields.
- `superset/reports/notifications/email.py`: `pytz.timezone("UTC")` → `zoneinfo.ZoneInfo("UTC")` for the `datetime.now(...)` stamp. Semantically identical here: for a fixed-offset zone like UTC there is no localization concern, and `tzname()` is still `"UTC"`, so subject-line date formatting is unchanged.

Accepted-timezone set is a strict superset of the previous one — verified against the installed tzdata:

```
$ python -c "import pytz, zoneinfo; a=set(pytz.all_timezones); z=zoneinfo.available_timezones(); print(len(a), len(z)); print(sorted(a-z)); print(sorted(z-a))"
597 599
[]            # nothing previously accepted is now rejected
['Factory', 'localtime']
```

### TESTING INSTRUCTIONS

```
$ python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/reports/schemas_test.py -q
34 passed, 1 warning in 0.44s

$ python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/reports/ -q
145 passed, 1 warning in 5.14s

$ ruff check superset/reports/schemas.py superset/reports/notifications/email.py
All checks passed!
```

The issue's second verification command (`python -c "import superset.reports.schemas as s; ..."`) cannot import the module standalone on `master` either — `superset.reports.models` raises `Exception: App not initialized yet` outside a Flask app. The equivalent source check via `importlib.util.find_spec` passes:

```
$ python -c "import importlib.util; p=importlib.util.find_spec('superset.reports.schemas').origin; assert 'pytz' not in open(p).read(); print('ok')"
ok
```

### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

body.body: ### SUMMARY Replaces `pytz` with the stdlib `zoneinfo` in `superset/tasks/cron_util.py`. ```py - tz = pytz_timezone(timezone) # UnknownTimeZoneError -> pytz_timezone("UTC") - utc = pytz_timezone("UTC") + tz: tzinfo = ZoneInfo(timezone) # (ZoneInfoNotFoundError, ValueError) -> timezone.utc + utc = timezone.utc ``` Semantics notes, since this is the call site where a naive swap is dangerous: - The function only ever attaches a timezone via `datetime.astimezone(tz)`, never by constructing a datetime with `tzinfo=tz` directly. That is exactly the pattern where `pytz`'s LMT-offset footgun does not apply, so no `localize()`/`normalize()` equivalent is needed — `ZoneInfo` resolves the offset from the datetime, which is the desired behaviour for windows spanning a DST boundary. The existing summer/winter (DST) parametrisations in `tests/unit_tests/tasks/test_cron_util.py` cover this and pass unchanged. - Fallback: `pytz` raises `UnknownTimeZoneError` for a bad name; `ZoneInfo` raises `ZoneInfoNotFoundError` for an unknown key and `ValueError` for a structurally invalid key (e.g. absolute or `..`-containing paths), so both are caught. The warning message and the UTC fallback are unchanged. - Fallback uses `datetime.timezone.utc` rather than `ZoneInfo("UTC")` so the fallback path cannot itself fail on a system without a tz database. - Output is unchanged: `schedule.astimezone(utc).replace(tzinfo=None)` still yields naive UTC datetimes, which is what the caller and the persisted schedule expect. - `datetime.timezone` is imported as `dt_timezone` because the function parameter is named `timezone`. Closes #2 ### TESTING INSTRUCTIONS ``` $ python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/tasks/test_cron_util.py -q 36 passed, 1 warning in 0.44s ``` `pre-commit run --files superset/tasks/cron_util.py` passes (mypy, ruff, pylint). ### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION - [x] Has associated issue: #2 - [ ] Required feature flags: - [ ] Changes UI - [ ] Includes DB Migration (follow approval process in [SIP-59](https://github.com/apache/superset/issues/13351)) - [ ] Migration is atomic, supports rollback & is backwards-compatible - [ ] Confirm DB migration upgrade and downgrade tested - [ ] Runtime estimates and downtime expectations provided - [ ] Introduces new feature or API - [ ] Removes existing feature or API Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/081c24c00d994ca3a8df78813277c419 ---
